_notes: Extreme vertical swings: 1.5m -> 8.5m -> 2.0m -> 10.5m altitude across 25m horizontal. Tests the iter-11 climb-inflation policy — any raw trajectory here would demand more vertical accel than the tilt-clamped DSLPIDControl can track. Uses default planner knobs only. Iter-12 baseline: 4/4 gates in 18.5s at 0.897m avg tracking error. Proves the iter-11 climb-ratio inflation generalizes to steeper (1.5→10.5m) vertical swings than field_demo (4m→10m) without any per-race tuning.
